title: Bronze Ingestion Spec
description: Defines how raw data is ingested into the Bronze zone.

source_path.description: S3 path or local path to raw source data

ingest_sequence_column.description: Name of a column Bronze STAMPS on every ingested row with the run's logical date, supplying a monotonic ordering across runs that the source itself does not provide. Bronze stays append-only: this ADDS a column, it never updates an existing row, so Bronze immutability holds. Silver then resolves same-primary-key conflicts by taking the highest value, which is the only way to apply an upstream restatement — a claim moving PENDING to PAID, say — when no source column changes on update. Point silver_spec.dedup_order_by at this column. Omit it when the source supplies its own reliable last-updated timestamp and order by that instead.
ingest_sequence_column.$comment: Needed because ingestion_mode: cdc was unimplementable on its own: a merge has to know which of two rows is newer, and a source whose update does not touch any column cannot say.

file_pattern.description: Glob pattern to match source files (e.g., *.csv)
